components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single strongest action in a task.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-control, 10px); background: var(--accent, #174a3b); color: var(--on-accent, #f8faf7); font: 680 14px/1.2 "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next", system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1), transform 160ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #123e31; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus-ring, #8cb5a2); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(.98); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A visible but quiet supporting action.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #d7dfd9); border-radius: var(--radius-control, 10px); background: var(--panel, #fcfdf9); color: var(--accent, #174a3b); font: 680 14px/1.2 "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next", system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1), border-color 160ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--accent, #174a3b); background: var(--accent-soft, #dce7df); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus-ring, #8cb5a2); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Solid labeled search and filter input.
components.html: <label class="ds-field">Search restaurants<input class="ds-input" type="search" placeholder="Cuisine, dish, or place"></label>
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: var(--ink, #161b18); font: 680 13px/1.2 "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #b9c7be); border-radius: var(--radius-control, 10px); background: var(--panel, #fcfdf9); color: var(--ink, #161b18); font: 400 16px/1.5 "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--accent, #174a3b); outline: 3px solid var(--focus-ring, #8cb5a2); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Playlist Chip
components.description: A compact playlist filter whose membership count stays explicit when other criteria narrow the visible queue.
components.html: 3 of 19 places
components.css: .ds-playlist-filter { display: flex; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; color: var(--muted, #52615a); font: 680 13px/1.2 "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-chip, .ds-show-all { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #d7dfd9); border-radius: 10px; font: inherit; } .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; background: var(--accent, #174a3b); color: var(--on-accent, #f8faf7); } .ds-show-all { background: var(--panel, #fcfdf9); color: var(--accent, #174a3b); } .ds-chip:hover, .ds-show-all:hover { border-color: var(--accent, #174a3b); } .ds-chip:focus-visible, .ds-show-all:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus-ring, #8cb5a2); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Restaurant Order Ticket
components.css: .ds-ticket { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) auto; gap: 12px; padding: 14px; border: 1px solid var(--accent, #174a3b); border-radius: var(--radius-control, 10px); background: var(--accent-soft, #dce7df); color: var(--ink, #161b18); box-shadow: 0 7px 18px rgba(23,74,59,.09); } .ds-ticket h3 { margin: 0; font: 700 19px/1.05 "Bricolage Grotesque", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-ticket p { margin: 7px 0 0; color: var(--muted, #52615a); font: 400 14px/1.4 "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-score { display: grid; justify-items: end; color: var(--highlight, #f05a28); } .ds-score small { color: var(--muted, #52615a); }

components.name: Primary Navigation
components.description: Places, Map, and Pick remain visible at every viewport.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3,1fr); gap: 4px; padding: 5px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #d7dfd9); border-radius: var(--radius-surface, 14px); background: var(--panel, #fcfdf9); } .ds-nav button { min-height: 44px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-control, 10px); background: transparent; color: var(--muted, #52615a); font: 680 14px/1.2 "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav button.active { background: var(--accent, #174a3b); color: var(--on-accent, #f8faf7); } .ds-nav button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus-ring, #8cb5a2); outline-offset: 1px; }

narrative.overview:
Table Notes borrows the useful rhythm of a restaurant pass: active choices stay visible, information is clipped into legible tickets, and the plated result gets the largest visual space. It combines that operational clarity with a photo contact sheet and personal annotations, creating a shared journal that feels specific to meals with friends rather than to business analytics.

The product is used repeatedly, often on a phone while a group is deciding where to eat. Expression therefore lives in the rail, ticket proportions, photo crops, typography, and concise interaction feedback. Navigation and editing remain familiar, fast, and quiet.
keyCharacteristics: A compact rail keeps Places, Map, Pick, search, and Add immediately available.
Restaurant rows resemble confident order tickets without becoming novelty paper props.
Food photography and friend opinions carry the detail view.
Forest is the structural brand color in light mode; dark mode uses warm charcoal, linen, amber, and the established Want-to-go purple.
Light and dark themes preserve the same hierarchy and component character.

rules.name: The Appetite Mark Rule
rules.body: Paprika never becomes general decoration. It identifies appetite, a selected result, or a consequential state.

rules.name: The Menu Voice Rule
rules.body: Labels state what people can do. Decorative uppercase, fake ticket numbers, and poetic microcopy are not part of the system.

rules.name: The Pass Surface Rule
rules.body: If a border already defines a surface, do not add a resting shadow. Depth must communicate state or layering.

dos: Do show real restaurant and dish photography as the primary visual material.
Do keep every existing workflow findable within the redesigned shell.
Do use Paprika Mark only for appetite and consequential decision states.
Do provide complete loading, empty, error, disabled, and permission states.
Do keep gesture shortcuts optional and pair them with visible controls.
donts: Don't imitate aged paper, handwritten notebooks, receipt printers, or novelty restaurant decor.
Don't use a generic metric-dashboard hero or equal card grid.
Don't hide editing, Want to go, reviews, or playlist management behind long press.
Don't animate frequent navigation or keyboard-driven actions.
Don't permanently remove shared content or associated media from the interface.
